scope: Real CPU/CUDA HG single-J component compatibility and native-ID/cache behavior. No solver trajectory, half-step chain, physical admission or production-source changes.

reuse.mechanism: Rename only retained main while including the unchanged source. Reuse State, positive-J V*rho inertia, directed dense oracle, exact phase helpers, history/virtual-work checks and predetermined tolerances. Compile the new translation unit without separately linking the included CPU fixture object. The included oscillator and retained main are not called.
reuse.legacy_requirement: Parent must compile/run the unchanged NULL-J GPU suite as a separate executable against the same authoritative fresh HG CPU/GPU objects. New JSON explicitly does not claim that suite executed. No frozen old HG object substitution.

fixture.geometry: Retained 8x10 two-dimensional X-periodic lattice, dp=.125, period1, h=.1625, support.325; native IDs40..119. Retained periodic and ignored/fixed slots do not carry independent HG state.
fixture.material: Reference mass20, rho0=2000, water rho1000, xi=.1, G1e5, bwen=-1; V=(M0/rho0)J and independently evaluated current mi=V*(rho_w+(rho0-rho_w)/J). H=Q/M0 and its rate are not current acceleration.
fixture.phases: Actual PredictorForce -> PredictorUpdate -> CorrectorForce -> CorrectorUpdate; dt1e-5. No particle/time advancement by a solver.
fixture.comparison: Real CPU, real GPU cache-on and real GPU cache-off. All normal native rates/history/statistics use original cross-backend tolerances. GPU cache variants must match bitwise. CPU-GPU maxactualnetforce differences remain descriptive because they include float force rounding, while independent actual-mi float balance and per-node acceleration checks are mandatory.

cases: J1, uniformJ=.8 and nonuniformJ, each translation/periodic-affine/checkerboard/random; original affine/null or non-affine oracle checks remain active

Fresh half-stage J and native reordering: predictor host J and predictor GPU J buffer are poisoned only after a separate valid half array is created; corrector uses its own current device J buffer. Its physical increment must be M0/currentmi times history, without a rate recalculation. Endpoint J/velocity/geometry then change and rates are recomputed.

Adjacent raw double J differing by one ULP with identical rounded V, constructed by the retained bounded2048 search; predictor must miss cached endpoint despite equal volume bits. The actual witness values are recorded.
Native reorder plus corrupted ignored periodic copies and one appended copy: exact native endpoint reuse, cache-on/off bit identity, no force on ignored slots.

Passive legacy Rhop is changed to zero/negative/NaN/infinity with identical dynamic-J state. Within the same GPU its cached endpoint rates/history remain bit-identical, and the independently recalculating GPU matches exactly. CPU-GPU remains tolerance based.

Missing, zero, negative, NaN, infinite J and overflowing current inertia are rejected by both real backends at predictor, corrector and endpoint. Predictor guards are exercised after populating a valid endpoint cache.

predeclared_gates.float_acceleration: 64*FLT_EPSILON; retained current-inertia oracle bound relative to the HG increment, with1e-30 arithmetic zero scale; cross-backend float Ace retains64eps*max(1,abs(CPU Ace)). Zero initial acceleration prevents a float subtraction floor from hiding stale mass.
predeclared_gates.double_history_net_reference_force: 1e-10*max(1e-15,sum_i M0*norm(history_i)), retained CPU oracle history gate
predeclared_gates.history: Included CPU dense-reference history uses1e-10*max(1e-15,reference scale); GPU/CPU history uses retained1e-8 relative-plus-absolute comparison. No gate is relaxed after observing results.

future_record: Fresh result path required. JSON passed means only this actual component suite passed; physical_acceptance=false and solver_run=false. Device/error/per-case metrics and the raw-J collision witness are recorded; the unchanged legacy NULL-J suite requires its separate actual result.
author_validation: Manual source/API review only. No syntax compilation, build, CUDA execution, solver, Git, or other-file changes by author. Parent owns full read and authoritative fresh-object linking after production builds.
